persisted_attempt_pod.field_source: sanitized Kubernetes Pod read response retained before cleanup

confirmed_facts: The persisted live pod used ClusterFirst and no custom dnsConfig.
The rendered NetworkPolicy permitted DNS only to the VPC resolver at 172.31.0.2/32.
The kube-dns Service had zero endpoints while both managed node groups were scaled to zero.
All five in-pod resolution attempts returned EAI_AGAIN before Torch import.
conclusion.recommended_correction: Set dnsPolicy=None and dnsConfig.nameservers=[172.31.0.2] on both evaluation pods, retain the strict DNS egress rule, and bind resolved private endpoint addresses to the rendered TCP/443 allowlist before pod launch.
